model_label: Literature-anchored 3D dynamic benchmark; prescribed reference flow and rigid lumen; not a reproduction of Tong's quasi-static experiment or full FSI

flow.closure: Prescribed curved-tube parabolic reference field; anisotropic linear resistive drag plus transverse quadratic drag and axial-spin viscous torque. Not a Navier-Stokes solution.

lumen.geometry: c(z)=(ax*sin(2*pi*z/L), ay*sin(pi*z/L), z); closest-point projection by Newton iteration
lumen.stage5_stress_note: Separate narrower rigid lumen; straight initial rod has small initial overlap. This tests active contact, not feasible navigation.

microgravity.buoyancy: Hydrostatic residual-g buoyancy approximation included once; prescribed drag omits pressure forces

controller.stage5_nominal_law: inherited static compliance feedforward plus position feedback, mapped to nominal currents by weighted ridge least squares
controller.stage5_executed_law: current-port correction, current-space constrained projection, continuous 2ms ramps; full Biot-Savart at every force evaluation

numerics.time_integrator: official PositionVerlet; explicit force-dependent kick; empirical order measured, no full-system symplecticity claim
numerics.boundary: fixed node 0 and first material frame; free distal end; no insertion in current benchmark

provenance.literature_source: Tong et al., Journal of the Mechanics and Physics of Solids 203 (2025) 106198, DOI 10.1016/j.jmps.2025.106198; published PDF p.10 section5.1 directly read and visually checked
provenance.uniform_shaft_assumption: Reported E/G refer to magnetic composite; assigning them to the full uniform rod is an explicit benchmark assumption, not evidence of the unmagnetized shaft's measured properties.
provenance.flow_note: rho=1060kg/m^3 and eta=0.0035Pa*s appear as modeling inputs in the primary numerical study DOI10.1186/s11671-015-1127-5; adopting them here is an engineering modeling choice, not a subject-specific measurement.
unvalidated: coil-current calibration and joint field/gradient bandwidth
